producer_report.summary: The root-cause request body now has two new paragraphs. The first asks that the information the failing stage lacked be given to it (brief, system facts or reader's inputs). The second allows a refusal rule only when giving that information cannot prevent the failure, and says the request must state the expected share of past accepted readings the rule would refuse. A new test checks the order of these phrases, using struct-update syntax for Records so clippy stays clean. CHANGELOG.md has an entry. The formatter, clippy --all-targets, the hestia tests and the policy test all pass. I did not run the full workspace test suite.

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test in crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs builds a root-cause request via root_cause_request from a fixture cause and records, and asserts the text asks first (earlier position) for the information the failing stage lacked to be supplied to it (brief, system facts or reader's inputs). Check: cargo test -p athena-core hestia passes with the test listed.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo test -p athena-core hestia: the_root_cause_request_asks_for_missing_information_before_allowing_a_refusal_rule ok; it asserts the ask and the brief/system facts/reader inputs phrase come before the refusal text.

criteria_check.criterion: The same test asserts a refusal rule is mentioned only as allowed when giving the information cannot prevent the failure, requires the request to state the expected share of past accepted readings it would refuse, and that mention comes after the information ask. Check: cargo test -p athena-core hestia.
criteria_check.evidence: Same test asserts ask < supplied < rule < share positions by find(); passed.

criteria_check.criterion: git diff of crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs shows the body in root_cause_request_at extended with the new paragraphs; the new test builds Records with struct-update syntax (no field assignment after Default::default()).
criteria_check.evidence: Two paragraphs added to the body String::from in root_cause_request_at; test uses Records { introspections: Vec::new(), ..Default::default() }; clippy clean.

criteria_check.criterion: Existing root-cause tests still pass, and the built request still passes plain_boundary_text and the no-bullet-line rule. Check: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: All 71 hestia tests pass including the existing root-cause ones; the new test unwraps root_cause_request (which runs plain_boundary_text and the bullet refusal). Full athena-core suite not run beyond the hestia filter.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks; I ran fmt and clippy --all-targets --locked -D warnings clean, and the hestia and policy tests.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry describing the root-cause template change (information first, refusal rule only with an expected refusal share). Check: git diff CHANGELOG.md.
criteria_check.evidence: New first bullet under Unreleased/Changed in CHANGELOG.md.

criteria_check.criterion: The changed files are only crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs and CHANGELOG.md. Check: git status.
criteria_check.evidence: git status --short shows only M CHANGELOG.md and M crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs.

mistakes: My first draft of the test asserted a refusal-rule count that the text did not satisfy, and a clumsy bullet check. I replaced both before running anything.
learnings: The Bash hook allows only cargo, chmod, git, ls, mv and rm, so no grep, head or tail pipes.
